items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Saka Acquaye. Philly had a lot of things with dance, congas, and drums...

ctx.x: Saka Acquaye. Philly had a lot of things with dance, congas, and drums, a lot of culture in Philly. We grew up with a lot of culture.
What centers, were there community centers, where was this music being performed and rehearsed? Was there a community center? Where did it germinate?
